purpose: Teach: インストラクター/障壁/離職/測量/バリアフリー/粉飾/生計/ステータス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、英語のインストラクターを利用しろ
lines.en: Ren — use the English instructor resource.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate instruction. Flat tone on the name. Pause between name and directive. Direct eye contact. The weight of experience behind each word, not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究分野の障壁を理解しております
lines.en: Yes. I understand the barriers within my research field.
lines.style: Steady, careful reply. Respectful but not obsequious. Slight hesitation — showing he's actually thinking through the problem, not just agreeing. Even pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、離職リスクのある共同研究者には連絡しろ
lines.en: Ren — reach out to any collaborators you think might leave.
lines.style: Second directive, same measured tone as the first. Slightly slower on the stakes. Not threatening, but serious. Boss knows what he's asking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験設備の測量を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm already working through the lab equipment survey.
lines.style: Quiet focus. Respectful and on-task. Slight internal strain showing — he's aware of the workload but not complaining. Steady delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のバリアフリー対応を提案しろ
lines.en: Ren — propose some accessibility improvements for the lab.
lines.style: Third instruction, same grounded delivery. This one carries different weight — less about crisis, more about culture. Still direct, but softer edges.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ粉飾は学術界の信用を失います
lines.en: Yes. I know that data integrity is what keeps science credible.
lines.style: Quiet conviction now. He's moved beyond just receiving orders — he's thinking about the why. Slight firmness on 'credible.' Still respectful, but his own voice coming through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究者として生計を立てる力を身につけろ
lines.en: Ren — develop the skills to actually support yourself as a researcher.
lines.style: Final directive. Tone shifts slightly — more personal now, less about immediate tasks. Slower. A glimpse of mentorship underneath the management. The real lesson.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文発表で研究者ステータスが上がります
lines.en: Yes. Building my publication record is how I establish myself.
lines.style: Closing reply, more settled now. He's absorbed the lesson. Quieter but firmer than before. Not reciting — genuinely answering. Slight exhale at the end.
